sentences: Okay, I want to plan the next two weeks with you, so take notes as I go.
First, the kitchen renovation starts on Monday, and the contractor said the crew arrives at eight in the morning.
Please remind me on Sunday evening to clear the counters and move the coffee machine into the dining room.
The plumber is booked for Wednesday afternoon, but he might need to come back on Thursday if the new pipes are late.
Can you keep a list of every invoice they send, with the amount and the date, so I can check them against the quote?
The quote was twelve thousand four hundred dollars, and I agreed to pay a third up front.
Second, my sister is visiting from Seattle on the fourteenth and staying for five nights.
She is vegetarian, so when you suggest restaurants, leave out the steak houses and the barbecue places.
I would like to take her to the botanical garden on Saturday, and to the jazz club near the river on Sunday night.
Please check whether the jazz club needs a reservation, and if it does, book a table for two at nine.
Third, work.
The quarterly report is due on the twentieth, and I still need the sales numbers from the Berlin office.
Send a short note to Martin asking for those numbers by Friday, and keep the tone friendly but clear.
I also promised to review the hiring plan before the leadership meeting, so block two hours on Tuesday morning for that.
If anyone asks for a meeting on Tuesday morning, decline it politely and offer Wednesday instead.
One more thing about the report: the charts from last quarter used the old colours, so ask the design team for the new template.
And remind me on Thursday afternoon to call the accountant about the tax forms for the new office.
Fourth, money.
Move five hundred dollars into the savings account on the first of the month, the same as last time.
The car insurance renews at the end of the month, so find me two other quotes before I decide whether to stay.
Also, the gym membership charges me every month even though I have not been since spring, so find out how to cancel it.
If they need a letter, draft one for me and I will sign it on the weekend.
Last thing, the garden.
The tomatoes need water every second day while it stays this hot, and the new roses need feeding on Saturday.
If it rains more than a centimetre, skip the watering and tell me in the morning.
The neighbours offered to lend us their ladder for the apple tree, so remember to return it by Sunday.
Order two bags of compost and a new hose from the garden centre, and have them delivered on Friday if possible.
If the delivery costs more than fifteen dollars, pick them up on Saturday morning instead.
That is everything for now, so read the list back to me tomorrow at breakfast, and thank you.
longB.note: Synthesized: one voice memo worded like a message to an assistant, sentence by sentence with 0.4 s gaps, and two 5 s pauses at one third and two thirds. Marked as synthesized until Ouou records it.
